answer: Blended streak over the last 5 epochs, with the beacon rotating mid-epoch so a canned paragraph stops working: the words nebula, nadir, timber must sit naturally in the text and the per-epoch window forces one submission per wallet. A 200-wallet farm needs 200 distinct credits, each credit one on-chain tx plus a text distinct enough to clear the duplication check, so faking one streak costs 200 txs a day and any missed epoch resets the chain. Attacker spend scales linear in wallets with no bulk discount; one human holding five wallets pays 5x for the same rank.
